transcript: Speaker A: रामू, यह बेड क्यों नहीं साफ हुआ अभी तक? पेशेंट आने वाला है 10 मिनट में। [Ramu, why hasn't this bed been cleaned yet? The patient is arriving in 10 minutes.] Speaker B: Sir, the bed four had a sudden episode. I had to assist the nurse first. I'm cleaning this bed right now. It will be ready in five minutes. Speaker A: एक मिनट, तुम इतनी अच्छी इंग्लिश कैसे बोल लेते हो? [One minute, how do you speak such good English?] Speaker B: सर, इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप से सीखी। इसमें एक्सपर्ट के छोटे-छोटे वीडियो हैं, हिंदी में समझा के इंग्लिश बोलना सिखाती हैं। रोज 15 मिनट देखता था ड्यूटी के बाद। [Sir, I learned from the English Seekho app. It has short videos by experts, explaining in Hindi to teach English speaking. I used to watch for 15 minutes daily after duty.] Speaker A: और बोलना कैसे सीखा? वीडियो से तो सिर्फ सुनना आता है। [And how did you learn to speak? You only learn to listen from videos.] Speaker B: ऐप में एआई कोच है सर, 24 घंटे अवेलेबल है। उससे रोज प्रैक्टिस करता था। गलत बोलता था तो सुधार देती थी। कभी जज नहीं किया, कभी नहीं बोला 'इतना भी नहीं आता तुम्हें'। धीरे-धीरे कॉन्फिडेंस आ गया। [There is an AI coach in the app, sir, available 24 hours. I used to practice with it daily. If I spoke incorrectly, it corrected me. It never judged, never said 'you don't even know this much'. Slowly, confidence came.] Speaker A: ट्रायल कितने का है? [How much is the trial?] Speaker B: सिर्फ ₹1 का सर। इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो और शुरू हो जाओ। [Just 1 rupee, sir. Download the English Seekho app and get started.] Speaker C: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, Disclaimer: English Seekho kisi bhi government authority, institution, brand, organisation ya individual ke dwara endorsed, sponsored, affiliated ya associated nahi hai... [Disclaimer: English Seekho is not endorsed, sponsored, affiliated, or associated with any government authority, institution, brand, organization, or individual...]
summary: A doctor is amazed when a hospital ward assistant speaks fluent English. The assistant credits his skills to the English Seekho app, highlighting its bite-sized Hindi-to-English lessons and 24/7 AI practice coach. The ad concludes with a call to download the app for a 1-rupee trial.
